scope: Focused cross-layer reliability audit, source corrections and full regression execution. No GitHub writes or production deployment.

toolchain.dependencies: Existing locked toolkit packages; no product dependency or lockfile change
toolchain.runtime_timestamps: Preserved as generated; package date follows conversation/session date

baseline.initial_harness_failure: Go embed setup overlapped first UI build; not a product defect; corrected order passed

native_processes.kind: Real compiled Linux worker/supervisor, loopback HTTPS + SQLite, actual signed replacement and bad-candidate recovery
native_processes.limit: Not native OS-service installation/boot, cross-schema future release, remote multi-host fleet or power-cut evidence

frontend.test_types: Node helpers, request logic and source-structure checks

repeat.scope: All TestV13 in runtime, spool, storage, server, jsonutil, checks

fuzz.scope: Bounded malformed/ambiguous JSON handling, not proof of exhaustive parser correctness

builds.windows_amd64: 4 commands cross-build PASS; not native execution

baseline_regressions.interpretation: Before/after scenarios, not thirteen independent security vulnerabilities

new_code_self_review.case: Pending retirement directory symlink could escape intended folder in first ledger draft

browser.new_case: Prior revision check data remains pending/fresh=false after config change; source fixture explicitly sends its fixed revision

browser.note: Host ran the revised Playwright scenario. Services table is not .service-row; pending text is asserted there and on Machine ServiceList after navigation. Assertions were not weakened.

not_accepted: native systemd/Windows SCM installation and boot
physical TV/Yandex and actual SSH shell/browser
power-loss durability especially Windows directory operations
compatibility: Server/UI and worker/service-host should be built from matching source
No re-enrollment, identity/key reset, configured endpoint change or new agent privileges
Wire schema and dependency lockfiles unchanged
spool/loss-ledger-v1.meta is new private metadata; preserve with queue
Old workers cannot maintain new loss accounting
Do not downgrade a controller during active V11+ rollout
